description: Apply the profile changes your insights suggest (adds tags, skill tags and categories proven by accepted work; never removes anything). Check my_insights first.

parts.description: Which parts to apply: skills, tags, categories. All by default.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: apply_insights
title: Update your profile from your record
